messages:
Avery (CS Lead): Heads up — prepping Meridian EBR for next Tue. Need slide owners, final demo readiness, and the executive asks. Can we do a 30-min dry run Thu?
Priya (Customer Success): I can own the account health + onboarding slide. Will pull open items and renewal signals by Wed noon.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll take the demo and runbook slide. Need the latest test data and the shortened demo script. Can someone confirm data availability?
Sam (Account Exec): Will draft the exec ask (5–7m) and the renewal posture summary. Ping me with any top risks — I want 1 slide.
Avery (CS Lead): Risks to surface: delayed integrations (2 customers), billing questions, one adoption cohort below target. Priya — can you annotate severity (high/med/low)?
Priya (Customer Success): On it. Quick note: onboarding for cohort B is delayed due to a missing SSO cert — Eng has the ticket but no ETA. Marking medium-high for now.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Data availability confirmed — staging snapshot v2026-03-18 exists. I'll trim to customer-relevant flows. Also will prepare a 60s fallback clip if live demo fails.
Sam (Account Exec): Exec ask draft: 1) approve 6-week extension for integration resources, 2) greenlight targeted enablement budget, 3) waive pilot billing for two accounts. Will share in thread by EOD.
Avery (CS Lead): Great. Run-of-show suggestion: 10m health overview, 7m demo, 5m exec asks, 8m Q&A. If demo needs more, swap from Q&A.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Proposed shortened demo script:
```
- 00:00 quick context
- 01:00 core flow (30s each for 2 features)
- 04:00 failure scenario + fallback
- 05:00 recap
```
Priya (Customer Success): I can have the risk heatmap + adoption metrics in a single slide. Will annotate actions and owners.
Avery (CS Lead): Can we list owners & due dates in this thread to sync? I'll collate.
Priya (Customer Success): Slide deck — slides 2–3 (health): Priya — due Wed 12:00pm
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Demo & runbook slide: Miguel — due Thu 9:00am (for dry run)
Sam (Account Exec): Exec ask + renewal posture: Sam — due Wed 6:00pm
Avery (CS Lead): Dry run Thu 10:30–11:00 PT. calendar-bot, please book a meeting.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled Thu 10:30–11:00 PT — Meridian EBR dry run (invites sent) :white_check_mark:
Priya (Customer Success): Also capturing enablement ask: 2 workshops targeted at power users (week after EBR). Will draft the ask and materials checklist.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Asking SRE to standby for demo. If we need a canned video, I have one ready.
Sam (Account Exec): One more ask — we should include net retention metric and a 3-month adoption forecast. Priya, can you add that?
Priya (Customer Success): Yes — adding NRR and a simple forecast chart. Will include assumptions.
Avery (CS Lead): Action items recap (I'll track):
- Priya: health slide + risk heatmap + NRR forecast — due Wed 12:00pm
- Miguel: demo + runbook + standby video — due Thu 9:00am
- Sam: exec ask + renewal posture slide — due Wed 6:00pm
- Avery: collate deck, finalize run-of-show, and run dry run — Thu 10:30
If anything slips, call it out here ASAP.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Also adding a small note for the deck: include a single "ask" slide with bold bullets for execs — 3 lines max.
Priya (Customer Success): Will add an action tracker slide with owners and dates.
Sam (Account Exec): I'll send a 1-paragraph pre-read for execs by Wed evening.
Avery (CS Lead): Excellent. If deploy or infra is needed, tag Eng and CC SRE. Otherwise see you all at the dry run. :thumbsup:
